verdict.rationale: The evidence documents fallback to another model when a request is rate-limited, plus weighted load balancing across models. These are separate fallback and load-balancing features, not spreading traffic across multiple keys or queuing and throttling requests. Nothing describes key pooling or rotation, request queuing, or rate throttling. Monthly spend caps limit spend, not request rate.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can smooth provider rate limits by spreading traffic across keys and queuing or throttling requests
